grid.layout_notes: Official sheet layout 32323 = reel heights 3-2-3-2-3 (108 ways: 3×2×3×2×3). Fire Frames can split symbols into two parts on 1–13 random positions.

win_system.notes: xWays / Fire Frame splits increase ways. Enhancer Cells can add xWays, xNudge, xSplit when 4 or 6 fire frames appear.

expanding_reels.how_it_works: Fire Frames split a symbol into two parts (1–13 random positions). xWays via Enhancer Cells expands ways.

other.name: Fire Frames
other.how_it_works: 1–13 random positions split a symbol into two parts.

other.name: Enhancer Cells
other.how_it_works: When 4 or 6 fire frames appear, enhancer boosts can include xWays, xNudge, xSplit and other boosters.

other.name: Mental Transform
other.how_it_works: Spider symbol landing transforms symbols on the reels.

scatters.name: Scorpion
scatters.behavior: 3 Scorpions activate Autopsy Freespins (sticky Fire Frames). Combined with Spider(s) upgrades bonus tier.

scatters.name: Spider
scatters.behavior: Triggers Mental Transform when landing. 3 Scorpions + 1 Spider → Lobotomy Freespins. 3 Scorpions + 2 Spiders → Mental Freespins. Sticky in Lobotomy/Mental modes.

multipliers.name: Dead Patient / Dead Multiplier
multipliers.behavior: Two Dead Patient symbols can award a random multiplier x5–x9999 on a patient symbol. In Lobotomy, Dead Multiplier transfers to a Patient symbol; in Mental Freespins it never decreases.

specials.name: Patient symbols
specials.behavior: Receive Dead Multiplier transfers for large wins during Lobotomy/Mental free spins.

base_game_loop.summary: Paid spin on 3-2-3-2-3 ways grid. Fire Frames may split symbols; landing two Dead Patients can roll x5–x9999; Spider triggers Mental Transform; Enhancer Cells fire when 4 or 6 frames appear. 3 Scorpions start Autopsy free spins, upgradable with Spiders to Lobotomy or Mental.

phases.name: Spin
phases.what_happens: Reels stop on 3-2-3-2-3. Random Fire Frames (1–13) may split symbols into two parts.

phases.name: Enhancers / transform
phases.what_happens: If 4 or 6 Fire Frames appear, Enhancer Cells may add xWays/xNudge/xSplit/boosters. Spider landing triggers Mental Transform.

phases.name: Dead Patient check
phases.what_happens: If two Dead Patient symbols land, roll random multiplier x5–x9999 onto a patient symbol.

phases.name: Evaluate ways wins
phases.what_happens: Pay left-to-right ways wins on the resulting grid.

phases.name: Bonus trigger
phases.what_happens: 3 Scorpions → Autopsy (sticky Fire Frames). 3 Scorpions + 1 Spider → Lobotomy. 3 Scorpions + 2 Spiders → Mental Freespins.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: After Fire Frames, enhancers, and transforms resolve, ways wins are paid; then scatter counts select bonus tier.
base_game_loop.notes: Exact free-spin counts per Autopsy/Lobotomy/Mental mode are not printed on the affiliate sheet.

## Dead Patient
Whenever you land two Dead Patient symbols you’ve got\nthe chance to win a massive random multiplier - ranging\nfrom x5 to x9999 on a patient symbol.

## Enhancer Cells
Boost the chance of wins whenever 4 or 6 fire frames\nappears. xWays, xNudge, xSplit along with other boosters.

## Mental Transform
Symbol transform feature whenever the Spider symbol\nlands on the reels.

## Autopsy Freespins
Activated by 3 Scorpion symbols and will trigger a bonus\nmode with sticky Fire Frames. May be upgraded to\nLobotoy or Mental Freespins.

## Lobotomy Freespins
Activated by 3 Scorpions plus a Spider symbol. An\nupgraded version of Autopsy, where the Spider symbol is\nsticky and award Mental Transform for each spin. Included\nDead Multiplier that is transferred to a Patient symbol to\ntrigger some immense wins. May be upgraded to Mental\nFreespins.

## !!!This is mental!!!
Max payout of the game is set to 66.666x times the base\nbet. Trigger this, and the game round will end.

## Mental Freespins
This is where things go really mental. Triggered by 3\nScorpion symbols and 2 spider symbols. Spider symbols\nare sticky and Dead Multiplier never decrease.
